items.html: It follows that when they are face to face, then Zeir Anpin has Panim and Achor of MaH of MaH, and of MaH of BaN; and likewise the Nukva has Panim and Achor of BaN of MaH, and Panim and Achor of BaN of BaN. However, it is found that every Sefirah of the ten Sefirot of ZA or of the Nukva has in it Panim and Achor of MaH, and Panim and Achor of BaN. And all this is in the matter of the externals, which are the vessels; and likewise in the matter of the lights — inner and surrounding, from the Panim and Achor of MaH, and inner and surrounding from the Panim and Achor of BaN. (But the doubt that I have is whether the circles were made from BaN and the straight line from MaH, or the circles from the Achor of BaN and the straight line from the Panim and Achor of MaH and from the Panim of BaN. And these doubts depend on the doubts that we explained in the RDLA; see there.)
